subject: Procurement intake sync: vendor setup & PO owner mapping
messages:
From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme-inc.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps Team <procureops@acme-inc.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + vendor intake / kickoff request

Hi Alex / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick chat last week. We're ready to begin the formal procurement intake for Redwood so we can get vendor setup and a PO in place ahead of the pilot.

High level ask: can we schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff this week to align on the vendor setup checklist (W-9 / company info / contract signatory), PO owner and timeline, and any security/compliance evidence we should expect?

Suggested attendees from our side: Jamie (Procurement Lead), Lydia Chen (Finance), and the ProcureOps queue for documentation.

If you could propose 2 time slots and an internal point of contact for PO creation, we can lock it in and I will circulate a mutual action plan afterward.

I've attached our vendor intake form (PDF) and a blank SOW template we sometimes use.

Thanks,

Jamie Torres
Lead, Procurement Operations
Acme Inc.
jamie.torres@acme-inc.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_vendor_intake_v1.pdf, standard-sow-template.docx

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + vendor intake / kickoff request

Hi Jamie — really appreciate the clear list. We're happy to kick this off.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-05-05 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2026-05-06 14:00–14:45

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m) — confirm who needs signoff for PO/SOW
2) Review vendor intake form fields and required artifacts (10m)
3) PO process owner & timeline (10m)
4) Security/compliance evidence & next steps (10m)
5) Action items / MAP & owners (5–10m)

Internal leads from Redwood:
- Alex Martinez — primary procurement contact / PM for onboarding cadence (will own MAP)
- Marissa Cole — billing & PO handoff (Finance liaison)
- Karthik Iyer — security/compliance questions (SOC 2 / data handling)

A few quick notes:
- For PO creation at Redwood, Finance needs the vendor legal name, remit address, and W-9 or equivalent. Marissa, can you confirm any minimum invoice visibility requirements we should tell Acme?
- Karthik, please flag any red lines in the intake form that would require a security review.

Jamie — if either slot works, send calendar invite and I will attach the MAP draft and our procurement checklist before the call.

Best,

Alex Martinez
Account Executive — Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + vendor intake / kickoff request

Thanks Alex / Jamie — I can do either slot but prefer Tue morning.

Quick clarifications from Finance:
- Minimum for PO setup: vendor legal name, tax form (W-9 for US entities or W-8BEN for foreign), remit address, and primary billing contact with email.
- We typically require net-30 unless a negotiated term is provided; we can discuss expedited payment options on the call if Acme needs faster payment.

I'll be prepared to take notes on the PO owner and estimated time-to-PO issuance. If Acme can complete the intake form before the call, that will speed things up.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Finance Manager — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks all — Tue 05/05 10:00 PDT works great. Invite is sent (Zoom).

I've attached the completed intake form with the legal name and remit address filled out; we still need a finalized SOW but that's fine for now. My notes below on success criteria so we're aligned before the call:
- PO raised within 10 business days after intake approval
- Billing contact established and invoicing cadence agreed (monthly)
- Security evidence: SOC 2 report and data processing addendum (DPA) — our security lead will validate but we expect those 2 items

Action items before the call:
- Acme to confirm any expedited payment needs (ProcureOps)
- Redwood to share MAP draft and procurement checklist (Alex)
- Karthik to add any immediate security must-haves to the intake form if applicable

See you Tue — thanks!

Jamie Torres
Lead, Procurement Operations
Acme Inc.
